correctness.rationale: Constant w3 and Fourier degree at most four reduce the centered support to r+Re(c2 e^{2i theta}+c4 e^{4i theta}) with r=Lambda/3. Convexity is a nonnegative degree-two trigonometric polynomial rho/r=1+2Re(d1 e^{i phi}+d2 e^{2i phi}), while area deficit is J=4(|d1|^2/3+|d2|^2/15). Fejer--Riesz writes rho/r=|a+b e^{i phi}+c e^{2i phi}|^2. At fixed |a|^2+|c|^2 the objective increases with |ac|, so |a|=|c|; writing their squared magnitude u gives J=(80u-156u^2)/15, uniquely maximized at u=10/39 with J=80/117. This yields A>=77*pi*Lambda^2/1053. Equality phases reduce by rotation to the displayed support, and its curvature factors as a nonnegative perfect square.
